projects.name: Solace Marina
projects.blurb: A slim glass tower on the marina edge with full-height windows and a sky pool.

projects.name: Canal Crest
projects.blurb: Compact, well-planned homes on the Dubai Water Canal, minutes from Downtown.

projects.name: Circle Gardens
projects.blurb: Garden blocks around a landscaped courtyard, the entry price of this collection.

projects.name: Harbour Lumen
projects.blurb: Twin towers facing the creek and the Downtown skyline, next to the creek park.

projects.name: Hills Arbor
projects.blurb: Mid-rise blocks on the central park, a short walk from the mall and schools.

projects.name: Meydan Lagoon Residences
projects.blurb: Twin residences beside a swimmable lagoon, between Downtown and Meydan.

projects.name: Furjan Grove
projects.blurb: Courtyard blocks next to Al Furjan metro, with the earliest handover here.

projects.name: Palm Azure Terraces
projects.blurb: Low-rise terraces stepping down to a private beach on the Palm trunk.

projects.name: Boulevard Spire
projects.blurb: A landmark tower on the boulevard with views of the Burj Khalifa and fountain.
